mapper.select: select dict.TABLE_ID tableId, bt.TABLE_NAME tableName, dict.DICT_ID dictId, dict.DICT_CODE dictCode, dict.DICT_NAME dictName, dict.DICT_TYPE dictType, dict.DICT_SOURCE dictSource, dict.UPDATE_TIME updateTime from BOK_TABLEDICT dict left join BOK_TABLELIST bt on bt.STATUS = 'E' and dict.TABLE_ID = bt.TABLE_ID where dict.STATUS = 'E' and dict.DICT_ID = #{dictId}

select count(1) from BOK_TABLEDICT dict,BOK_SCENECONFIG conf where dict.DICT_CODE = conf.NODE_ID and dict.STATUS = 'E' and conf.STATUS = 'E' and dict.DICT_ID = #{dictId} and (dict.DICT_CODE != #{dictCode} or dict.DICT_TYPE != #{dictType} or dict.DICT_SOURCE != #{dictSource})
